_comment: Large patches of overgrowth lie over the ground the Age generates, about twenty-five blocks across, and
spread from there as roots do. Each step makes a chunk likelier to hold one, so an Age reaches the top
of this ladder with a patch every handful of chunks rather than a single patch nobody walks into.
Harmful, since the thorns hurt and the roots eat what they reach. Only ground generated after the Age is
written, and leans humid, where an overgrowth is likeliest to be believed.
